# The data the nn gates need, pinned by content. `go test ./...` skips those
# gates because nobody keeps 300MB of checkpoints in a checkout, so the
# Neural Network Data Gates workflow fetches the files listed here and checks
# every one against its sha256 before running the tests.
#
# Each line is: <sha256>  <path under the data directory>  <source URL>
# A .gz source is decompressed after download. The model URLs name a commit or
# a revision rather than a branch, so the bytes cannot move under the checksum.
#
# Docs/nn.md points a local run at this file as well.
